LESSON: COMMUNITY NEEDS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: Citizenship 1.1 Concept of Community Service Learning (CSL) (6 Lessons) By the e
Topic 1.2: Community Needs
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Community Needs, part of Citizenship 1.1 Concept of Community Service Learning (CSL) (6 Lessons) By the e in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: How can we determine needs to be addressed in the community?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Community Needs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: Learners speak engagingly as they discuss relevant community partners with

whom they could forge partnerships for acquisition of resources to address different needs for CSL activities

● Digital Literacy: Learners use digital devices with assistive technology to create a database on identified

community needs.

Values:
Unity: Learners display team spirit as they collaboratively explore the community for various locally available

resources for CSL activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Civic Responsibility: Learners develop civic responsibility as they explore the community for various locally available

resources for CSL activities.

Suggested learning resources:

Digital devices with assistive technology, braille reference materials, print reference materials with appropriate font and

colour contrast, print and braille learner’s books, braille and print writing materials.
